expected.method: Blended score per number: 35% long-run frequency, 40% recent frequency (last 100 draws, exponentially decayed, half-life 30 draws) and 25% overdue-ness (draws since last seen vs. the expected gap, capped at 3x), each min-max normalised. 'Top scores' takes the highest-scoring numbers; the other sets are sampled from the hot, overdue and blended distributions and kept only if their odd count and sum fall inside the historic interquartile range. The letter is chosen by decayed letter frequency. Walk-forward backtest over the last 200 draws compares the average number of main-number hits of 'Top scores' with the random expectation.
expected.disclaimer: Lottery draws are random and every combination is equally likely. These picks are a statistical curiosity for entertainment only; they do not improve your odds. Please play responsibly.
